name: Marble Statue
description: You as a marble statue; then you slowly turn your head and smile. Side by side with your photo.

photo.label: A clear photo of your face

fixed.keyframe_prompt.text: Image 1 is a photo of a person. Make a picture of the exact person from image 1 as marble statue. Keep the same face, skin tone, age, hair and identity as image 1. One person, vertical portrait framing, the face clearly visible, high detail, no text, no watermark.
fixed.motion_prompt.text: They slowly turn their head and smile. Smooth, natural motion; the subject stays recognisable. Only the subject moves, alone in the frame; the background stays plain and still. Static shot.
